SELECT draft_id AS draftId, student_id AS studentId, lesson_id AS lessonId, question_id AS questionId, schema_version AS schemaVersion, document_json AS documentJson, revision, base_submission_version AS baseSubmissionVersion, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM biz_flowchart_draft WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND question_id = #{questionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_flowchart_draft (student_id, lesson_id, question_id, schema_version, document_json, revision, base_submission_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{lessonId}, #{questionId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{documentJson}, 1, #{baseSubmissionVersion}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE draft_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(draft_id)

INSERT INTO biz_flowchart_draft (student_id, lesson_id, question_id, schema_version, document_json, revision, base_submission_version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{lessonId}, #{questionId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{documentJson}, 1, #{baseSubmissionVersion}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE schema_version = VALUES(schema_version), document_json = VALUES(document_json), revision = revision + 1, base_submission_version = VALUES(base_submission_version), update_time = NOW()
